string.text: Draws MSDF reticles with their distance field and glow. Off draws them from coverage alone with the old colouring, for comparison.
Scale on each reticle's authored brightness.
Scale on the size of the glow around lit reticles, on top of each reticle's own glow size.
Scale on how strong the glow is against the lit core. 0 turns the glow off.
How much the glow follows the eye's adaptation: 1 scales it like the core, higher keeps it small by day and large at night.
The darkest scene the glow's exposure still adapts to. Lower lets a reticle bloom more at night than the game's own tone map allows the scene.
The brightest the glow gets on screen, below white, so the reticle's lines still read inside a strong glow.
How fast light brighter than the screen turns the core white. 0 keeps the core coloured.
How much the glow covers the image behind it instead of adding to it. Higher keeps it coloured over a bright sky.
Scale on the authored brightness of holographic sights.
Scale on the authored laser speckle and noise of holographic sights.
0 draws lines thinner than a pixel with their true darkness, 1 draws them bold.
